capabilities: : Connect documents and sources in a graph
disambiguation: Not merely a graph visualization tool; it organizes research into dossiers that include linked notes, attachments, and relationship history.
extras: Requires manual backup of the hidden .twdata folder; a separate web application version is available. Requires Obsidian 1.14.4 or newer.
intentEvidence: TraceWeave adds a graph of explicit relationships to your Obsidian vault so you can follow sources, distinguish hypotheses and return to your conclusions.
motivation: To provide a way to follow sources, distinguish hypotheses, and return to conclusions within a research project.
problem: Research materials often become fragmented across various notes and files, making it difficult to track relationships between sources and hypotheses.
summary: TraceWeave adds a graph of explicit relationships to Obsidian notes, allowing users to track sources, hypotheses, and related files in a centralized research dossier.
